scope: Current Research Library. Older editions remain in the separately labelled archive. Research and Astrology are separate.
reading_contract: A record_url links parts_index, original_url and source_links_url. Follow every next until end_of_document; verify text_sha256 if completeness matters. Source dates and scopes remain independent.
rule: Navigation only. Each record owns its dates, source scope and uncertainty. Collection membership is not agreement or proof.

http_client_guidance.default_python_client: HTTP 403 at the hosting boundary; no Library release header.
http_client_guidance.rule: Use an honest descriptive client identity and follow the bounded directory. Report client-specific failures; this does not establish every crawler’s access. Hosting protection and credentials are unchanged.
